description: This source file defines an Android activity named ObbMountActivity, which demonstrates managing OBB files by mounting and unmounting, handling user interactions via buttons, and updating UI components based on the OBB state. It includes event listeners, lifecycle methods, and references to Android system services related to storage management.

classes.name: ObbMountActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling OBB file mounting/unmounting, UI interactions, and system storage management.

classes.name: ObbState
classes.description: A helper class to retain the state of the OBB storage manager, status text, and path during configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, event listeners, and retrieves previous state if available.

methods.name: onRetainNonConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Retains the ObbState object across configuration changes to preserve storage manager state and UI info.
